capabilities: Plan daily tasks in HH:mm time blocks from a Markdown checklist
Automatically mark past planner items complete as the day progresses
Display today's tasks on a vertical timeline view
Show current task progress in the status bar with task notifications
Attach the planner to daily notes or any note via File, Command, or Daily mode
disambiguation: Not the evolved Day Planner with drag-and-drop and weekly view; this fork preserves the original plugin's features, with the Mermaid Gantt chart disabled.
extras: Warns that the plugin rewrites note contents (can conflict across synced devices), recommends testing in a test vault and backing up notes; the Mermaid Gantt chart feature from the original is disabled; BRAT is documented as an install option.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of the early Obsidian Day Planner plugin written by James Lynch.
motivation: The author forked the original Day Planner plugin and keeps the original behavior for stability rather than following the evolved version with new features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule tasks into time blocks, track them as the day progresses, or show current progress.

relations.evidence: a fork of the early Obsidian Day Planner plugin written by James Lynch
The Daily notes plugin must be enabled.

summary: Fork of the original Day Planner plugin that manages timed daily tasks from a checklist in a Markdown note.
